module_role: Project/title-block facts, full supplied-sheet ledger, scale boundary and complete visual-review disposition for all source pages.

sheet_details.sheet_ledger_semantics: All 28 supplied PDF pages have a retained full-page Poppler render and a completed visual-review disposition. Sheet identifiers and titles are transcribed from reviewed title blocks.

scale_semantics.takeoff_scale_status: No global drawing scale is asserted. The set mixes schedules, diagrams, notes, plans, details and sections; no local scale is promoted into a document-wide quantity conversion.
printed_local_view_scales_observed: N.T.S. appears on individual control-detail views.
scale_semantics.boundary: Schedule, legend and schematic facts are retained as source-bound text/table facts, not distance-based takeoff quantities.
